result.summary: Implemented Iteration 1/4 of ISS-0100: created migrations/GBL-102_iss503_guard_tenant_type_scope.sql (renumbered from the design's proposed GBL-086 -- GBL-097 through GBL-101 had already landed on main by implementation time, so GBL-086 was rejected by the migration runner's strict out-of-order guard; GBL-102 is the next free number after the actual on-disk highest, GBL-101). It republishes GBL-084's full RLS-removal body unchanged except the pre-flight guard's WHERE clause now adds 'AND tenant_type = ''production'''. Edited tests/integration/helpers.zig's ensureDefaultOidcSeeds SVC-01..04 fixture INSERT to add tenant_type='test' + production_tenant_id=<default tenant uuid> to all 9 rows per design section 3.1. During validation, discovered that this change alone regressed the full integration suite (132 pass / 404 fail vs a 462 pass / 74 fail baseline) because search_path is tenant_default,public at the point ensureDefaultOidcSeeds runs, and a pre-existing, previously-undocumented shadow tenant_default.tenant table (created by an unqualified CREATE TABLE in migration 031, never GBL-080-migrated since GBL-prefixed migrations are public-only by design) does not have the tenant_type column -- so the unqualified INSERT resolved against the wrong table. Fixed by schema-qualifying all tenant references in ensureDefaultOidcSeeds as public.tenant. Filed the shadow-table drift and a separate, independently-reproducible cold-start OutOfOrderMigration false positive as ISS-0101 (GitHub issue #359), since both are genuine pre-existing defects discovered as a byproduct of this work, confirmed via baseline (no-ISS-0100-changes) comparison on the same fresh/warm db_test states.

issues.description: Design doc section 5.2 point 5 numbered this migration GBL-086 based on a point-in-time listing where GBL-085 was the highest allocated number; by implementation time GBL-097-101 had already landed on main, so GBL-086 was rejected by the runner's out-of-order guard. Renumbered to GBL-102 (documented in the file's own header comment) -- no design change needed, purely a numbering-currency issue.

Filed as ISS-0101 (GitHub #359): a pre-existing shadow tenant_default.tenant table (from unqualified CREATE TABLE in migration 031_adp04b_tenant_realm_binding.sql) causes schema drift that broke the mechanical tenant_type addition to helpers.zig's SVC fixture INSERT until schema-qualified as public.tenant. Also documented an independently-reproducible OutOfOrderMigration false positive on a truly cold-started db_test, confirmed pre-existing on main via baseline comparison. Neither blocks normal pipeline operation (long-lived db_test masks both) but both are latent risks for any future environment reset.
